title: Feature intro
description: The first visit of a feature (L14): a small dialog with a visual, a title, one line, dots, “Bỏ qua” and “Tiếp” / “Bắt đầu”. Shown once per user per id; “seen” lives in a store (localStorage by default, pass your own to keep it per account). It waits while another dialog is open.
when: A new or reworked feature people already in the app should notice once (a new workspace, a new way to compare quotes).
“Xem lại giới thiệu” from a Help menu (forceOpen).

instead.need: A page that is empty on first use
A one-line tip next to a control

a11y: A modal dialog named by the slide's title and described by its line: focus moves to the primary, Tab stays inside, Escape and the backdrop skip, focus returns to where it was.
It never opens over another dialog: it waits until no aria-modal dialog is on the page. The step (“Bước 1 / 3”) is screen-reader text; the dots are decorative.

examples.title: Once per user
examples.description: Mount it on the feature's page with an id; here a button shows it again (forceOpen).

examples.title: Your own store
examples.description: Keep “seen” on the account instead of the browser.

notes: The store is read after mount only, so the server HTML never contains the dialog; blocked storage counts as seen.
At most three slides; one sentence each. One FeatureIntro per page.
